headline: Rainbow Children’s Medicare reports Q2 revenue up 23% and profit up 11%
hook: Steady expansion lifts mid-tier healthcare earnings
summary: Rainbow Children's Medicare posted a 23 percent increase in revenue and an 11 percent rise in net profit for the second quarter. EBITDA grew by 14 percent year-on-year alongside ongoing network expansion into Nellore and Guntur. The hospital chain also scheduled the launch of its Indore facility for the third quarter of fiscal 2027. Retail investors tracking hospital stocks can gauge steady operational scaling and margin trends from these results.
why_it_matters: Steady earnings and expansion reinforce hospital sector fundamentals for investors.

headline: Four Nifty 500 stocks closed above VWAP
hook: Four stocks showing strong intraday momentum
summary: On October 14, four Nifty 500 stocks, including Rainbow Children's Medicare, closed more than 1.5% above their Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP). This technical indicator suggests increased buying interest and positive momentum for these specific equities. Retail investors often use VWAP to gauge whether a stock is trading at a premium or discount relative to its average daily price.
why_it_matters: Signals potential short-term buying interest in these specific stocks.
winners_losers: Momentum traders gain / Short sellers hurt

headline: Rainbow Children's Medicare and two others close above VWAP
